description: Full structured per-section breakdown of a completed audit, on demand (only call after get_audit when you need depth): per-dimension FIND/READ/USE sub-scores, reputation across AI engines, competitor cluster (named for paid tiers), crawl/schema/robots findings, agentic-readiness + USE functional probes, and rendered-DOM analysis (paid). Typed, sanitized, size-capped (see truncated/dropped_sections). Composite *_score fields listed in experimental_fields may change methodology — do not hardcode thresholds. Also surfaces author/E-E-A-T, content freshness, images, hreflang, per-page per-bot access, Schema.org Action microformats, OpenAPI sub-metrics, Google Intelligence, product readability, site maturity, and a methodology block — each tagged with an availability state in the `availability` map (present | not_detected | not_run_free_tier | phase_c_disabled | probe_failed | truncated | not_measured_legacy). Wave C adds deterministic signals: homepage content quality (named quotes, stats-with-source, answer-shape) under crawl.content_signals; per-page video + per-locale schema in page_signals; OpenAPI per-operation coverage %, OAuth scopes, and MCP tool annotations in agentic_detail.use_probes; and self-disclosed trust claims (certifications, SLA/uptime, AI-content disclosure, verifiable-claims) under agentic_detail.trust_claims — each labeled "disclosed"/"mentioned" (never "verified") with an evidence URL and extraction-confidence. All carry an availability state in the `availability` map.

audit_id.description: The audit_id returned by run_audit / compare_aeo (poll until status is completed).

name: get_audit_detail

agentic_detail.description: Agentic readiness: structured_data, trust, mcp_readiness, agent_card, use_probes, trust_claims.

availability.description: Per-section availability state map (present | not_detected | not_run_free_tier | ...).

competitors.description: Competitor cluster (named on paid tiers; coarse bucket otherwise).

dropped_sections.description: Names of sections shed for size.

experimental_fields.description: Composite *_score paths whose methodology may change without a schema bump.

methodology.description: Scoring version, pillar weights, the USE rebuild recipe (use_rollup: detail-path weights + ordered rules), find_rollup {status, weights, inputs} (pillar FIND ≈ round(Σ weights[k]×inputs[k]); status is an open enum — only "ok" guarantees weights/inputs, treat any other value as not rebuildable), and methodology notes.

page_signals.description: Per-page rollups: author/E-E-A-T, freshness, images, hreflang, video, locale schema.

product_readability.description: Product-page readability score + coverage + top issues.

tool_description_quality.description: LLM-judged MCP tool-description quality (OMITTED unless state 'judged').

truncated.description: True if any sections were shed to fit the byte cap.
